name: Accretion Disk
desc: A bare differentially-rotating accretion disk seen at a steep inclination — hot inner gas shearing around a bright central compact object, one limb Doppler-beamed brilliant and blue as it sweeps toward you while the receding limb dims and reddens, spiral density waves and orbiting hotspots winding through the plasma.

hue.doc: warm/cool temperature bias of the disk (cool hue = hotter/bluer)

style.doc: black-body vs exaggerated-doppler vs hot-magnetized vs schematic streamlines
